content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP Certification in Biloxi

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: Verify you meet PMI's education and project-management experience requirements for the PMP credential. Review the specific hours and years of hands-on leadership experience needed. Granite PM Academy's admissions team can clarify your qualifications before enrollment.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours of Training
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led PMP Boot Camp. Attend all sessions synchronously with experienced instructors who cover the PMBOK Guide framework, real-world case studies, and exam-focused content. This formal education satisfies PMI's requirement and prepares you for application.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: File your PMP application directly with PMI, documenting your education completion and project experience. Pay the applicable exam fee to PMI. Granite PM Academy provides guidance on application details to ensure accuracy and avoid processing delays.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Take the Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-prep resources, including practice tests, question reviews, and strategy sessions. Schedule your official PMP exam through PMI's testing partner. Sit for the computer-based exam with confidence, knowing you've trained with a PMI Authorized Training Partner.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your PMP Credential
steps_items.text: Earn Professional Development Units (PDUs) throughout your three-year certification cycle by pursuing continuing education, volunteer work, or professional involvement. Before cycle end, report your PDUs to PMI to renew. Granite PM Academy offers ongoing resources to support your professional growth.
